## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] Formatting, lint, type checks, tests, and build run locally (or exceptions explained)
- [ ] Security and privacy implications reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## Risks and rollback

List known limitations, rollout dependencies, and a safe rollback path. Do not include secrets or sensitive request data.

## Merge readiness

Confirm that required quality and security checks pass, review conversations are resolved and the change contains only product code, tests, public configuration or technical documentation.
